name: Abdul El-Sayed
role: Michigan Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate (2026); former Detroit and Wayne County health director
summary: A physician-trained public health official who ran for Michigan governor in 2018 and the U.S. Senate in 2026. He campaigns for Medicare for All, higher taxes on the very wealthy, union rights, banning corporate campaign money, abolishing ICE and an arms embargo on Israel, while calling himself a regulated-capitalism supporter rather than a socialist.

universal-healthcare.rationale: His central 2026 Senate platform is Medicare for All covering everyone from cradle to grave without premiums, copays or deductibles; he also backed single-payer in 2018.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: 2018 platform listed raising the minimum wage; 2026 platform says every worker deserves a fair wage and one job should pay enough to raise a family. No 2026 figure given.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Says capitalism is supply and demand allocating scarce resources and he believes in that, but insists markets need rules and anti-monopoly enforcement, and backs a government-run health system.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Supports a billionaire wealth tax over $1 billion, higher marginal rates over $1 million, taxing capital gains like ordinary income and closing the stepped-up basis loophole.

unions-good.rationale: Says every worker deserves the right to join a union and that unions must have a significant voice in economic decisions; is a union member and backs the PRO Act.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Calls for a muscular FTC enforcing anti-monopoly law, accountability for corporations and polluters, and says capitalism has to be regulated.

cut-welfare.rationale: Opposes cuts to Medicaid and ACA subsidies and wants to expand guaranteed benefits; did not address dependency claims directly.

state-harmful.rationale: Describes his career as building government agencies that work for people and campaigns on a government that works for people.

limit-guns.rationale: 2018 campaign backed universal background checks, no gun possession for convicted domestic abusers and confronting the gun lobby. No 2026 gun plank found.

empower-police-military.rationale: Mixed: said in 2020 he wanted to disinvest from policing and re-fund social services; in 2026 says he supports investing in law-enforcement recruitment, retention and retirement. Also opposes foreign military funding.

rehabilitation.rationale: 2018 platform stressed moving from prison to productive citizenship and considering commutations for people sentenced as minors who are low risk.

abortion-legal.rationale: Pledges to codify the rights once protected by Roe v. Wade into federal law; 2018 platform also pro-choice.

more-religion-public.rationale: 2018 platform called for strict separation of church and state; 2026 platform affirms freedom of and from religion.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Platform seeks cannabis-industry access for communities hurt by the War on Drugs and makes environmental justice an explicit federal mandate.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Says people come to America to build, wants a pathway to citizenship for those in limbo and farmworker legal status; supports border enforcement but does not call for lower levels.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Wants US to engage meaningfully with the WHO, COP and Paris Agreement, to fund UNRWA, and to lead in rebuilding postwar international organizations; no statement about giving them more power.

free-trade.rationale: Calls NAFTA-style deals a disaster for manufacturing and says trade deals negotiated without unions siphoned jobs; 2018 platform said free trade deals favor elites over workers.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Has cited US action in Serbia in the 1990s as beneficial intervention (per Wikipedia), though he opposes the Iran war and most foreign military aid.

open-borders.rationale: Says he believes in a safe, secure border and immigration enforcement under a new structure.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Calls the climate crisis here now; pledges a pathway to 100% renewable energy, codifying the Endangerment Finding and strong federal action.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Supports taxing inheritance above $1 million like ordinary income and a progressive tax on wealth held by trusts.

basic-income.rationale: Supports exploring income protection such as wage insurance and basic income as automation responses; not a committed unconditional-UBI plan.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Supports targeted, smart tariffs to protect and incubate Michigan manufacturing and growth industries, sunsetting as firms mature; criticizes blanket Trump tariffs.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Supports public investment and targeted tariffs to build the technologies of the future, and wants taxpayers to earn returns from publicly funded research.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Wants to ban large corporations that speculate on housing from owning homes and to redirect farm subsidies from agribusiness to family farms.

democracy-best.rationale: Describes democracy as worth protecting, calls the right to be heard at the ballot box fundamental, and frames the Ukraine war as democracy versus autocracy.

separate-church-state.rationale: 2018 platform called for strict separation of church and state; 2026 platform affirms freedom of and from religion.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Follows from his stated call for strict separation of church and state and freedom from religion.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Said he does not believe in ethnostates, applying that to Israel, Egypt and Saudi Arabia, and that the US should not sustain them.

taxation-theft.rationale: No recorded position found: only general rights pledges, which do not address this statement.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Contested: declines to affirm a right to exist as a Jewish state and says he does not believe in ethnostates, while saying he supports self-determination for Palestinians and Jewish Israelis alike.

school-vouchers.rationale: Opposes vouchers and other programs that move public money to private schools.

national-self-determination.rationale: Supports self-determination for Palestinians and Jewish Israelis alike and says Taiwan's future should be chosen by Taiwanese democratically.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: No recorded position found: only general rights pledges, which do not address this statement.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Says oil and gas dependence poisons air and enriches corporations; pledges a path to 100% renewable energy and supports shutting down Line 5.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Says the fundamental corruption of politics is a system letting corporations and billionaires buy politicians who rig it against ordinary people.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Pledges to protect the rights of all Americans regardless of origin, faith, orientation, gender identity, age or income.

restrict-conversion.rationale: No recorded position found: only general rights pledges, which do not address this statement.

party-controls-media.rationale: No recorded position found: only general rights pledges, which do not address this statement.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: No recorded position found: only general rights pledges, which do not address this statement.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Says security comes from standing with democratic allies and cooperation, not from ending alliances.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Supports immediate reinvestment in foreign aid, including UNRWA, saying reducing deprivation and disease abroad serves safety and prosperity and is more than charity.

precautionary-principle.rationale: Wants federal agencies empowered to stop polluters before they cause harm and stronger cumulative-impact air standards.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Supports higher marginal rates on income over $1 million and a cost-of-living exemption up to $50,000.

apostasy-punishable.rationale: No recorded position found: only general rights pledges, which do not address this statement.

women-must-cover.rationale: No recorded position found: only general rights pledges, which do not address this statement.

ban-cartels.rationale: Backs a muscular FTC, the Break Up Big Medicine Act and breaking up monopolies including in healthcare.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Wants to close the Social Security payroll tax cap to keep the public system solvent.

corporate-influence.rationale: Refuses corporate money and backs overturning Citizens United, banning SuperPAC and 501(c)(4) spending, and public election funding.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Pledges to protect rights regardless of sexual orientation.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Calls the right to speak against government and peacefully protest sacrosanct and opposes using the state to intimidate protest.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: No recorded position found: only general rights pledges, which do not address this statement.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Pledges to protect people regardless of gender identity and backs gender-affirming care decisions staying with patients and doctors.

left-right-obsolete.rationale: Said he does not believe in left and right but in whether one works for the system locking people out or unlocking it; did not speak of combining the best ideas of each.

social-market-economy.rationale: Describes himself as a capitalist who believes capitalism must be regulated, pairing markets with anti-monopoly enforcement and guaranteed healthcare.

property-franchise.rationale: Wants voting made easier with automatic registration and election-day holidays.

racial-franchise.rationale: Wants voting made easier and universal with automatic registration; protects rights regardless of origin.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Calls for right-sizing taxes to confront the outsized power of excess wealth in the economy and democracy.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Says he does not support defunding the police and never called for abolishing prisons; 2020 remarks advocated shifting some police funds to social services.

rent-control.rationale: In 2018 supported repealing Michigan law blocking local rent control; 2026 platform proposes a federal renters bill of rights, not rent caps.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: Supports taxing capital gains over $1 million at ordinary income rates.

local-essentials-public.rationale: Wants investment in public clinics and hospitals and a federal water guarantee with capped bills; does not explicitly call for public ownership.

free-public-college.rationale: Says every student deserves a debt-free and tuition-free path through college or apprenticeship; 2018 plan also had tuition-free college.

arms-reduction.rationale: Opposes a zero-sum arms race with China as making everyone less safe and favors diplomacy over escalation.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Supports every worker's right to join a union and unions having a significant voice in economic decisions and the PRO Act.

voter-id.rationale: Opposes mandatory voter ID laws such as the SAVE Act and wants automatic registration and easier voting.

targeted-social-spending.rationale: Champions universal programs (Medicare for All for everyone, universal childcare and pre-K) rather than poverty-targeted ones.

no-business-privileges.rationale: Pledges to fight corporate tax breaks and the capture of the economy by billionaires.

notes: Positions on policing changed: in 2020 he endorsed shifting police funds to social services ('defund' in his words), while in 2026 he says he does not support defunding and backs law-enforcement recruitment and retention. On Israel he declines to affirm a right to exist as a Jewish state, which is recorded as contested (0). Many broad-liberty answers (religion, expression, voting) rest on his general platform commitments at medium confidence. Unreachable: web.archive.org (blocked), 2018 campaign site, Jewish Insider, Mediaite, Metro Times (403), his books and podcast (no full text obtained).
